question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM to replace the italicised word.

Actions done with *malice* have no good intention.
solution:
The correct answer is '***Good Will'.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The italicized word is' malice' whose meaning is '**the desire to harm someone or ill will'. (**दूसरों को मानसिक पीड़ा पहुँचाने की अभिलाषा, दुर्भावना)
 
• **'Goodwill'** means '**friendly, helpful, or cooperative feelings or attitude'. (**दूसरों के प्रति सद्‌भाव)
 
• So the meaning of the above two words is opposite to each other.
 
• Therefore the antonym*** ***of the word '***malice'*** is '***goodwill'***. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Animosity'** means a** strong feeling of dislike or hatred. (**शत्रुता, वैरभाव)
 
• **'Enmity'** means a** state or feeling of active opposition or hostility. (**शत्रुता, वैर)
 
• **'Rancor' **means '**bitterness or resentfulness, especially when long-standing'. (**द्वेष)
